The horse is a paid actor🐴
 
A lot of experimentation and a centuries-old Japanese puppet theatre tradition helped shape Ubisoft Bordeaux's 2D-inspired approach to art and level design. The result? For the Assassin's Creed Shadows: Claws of Awaji Expansion, every frame, every light, and every movement had a role to play.
 
Full Passion Meets Craft episode available now on our channel! 🎬
title: Passion Meets Craft: The Horse Is a Paid Actor 🐴

author: Ubisoft
description:
Passion Meets Craft explores the people, dedication and intent driving creativity around games. This time, through the craftsmanship behind Assassin's Creed Shadows: Claws of Awaji's theatrical approach to art and level design.

When games are built like a stage, you're the star of the show. 🫵

As we celebrate 40 years, Passion Meets Craft continues to pull back the curtain on the people and dedication behind the games we create.
 
For Assassin's Creed Shadows: Claws of Awaji Expansion, Ubisoft Bordeaux's artists and level designers drew inspiration from Awaji's centuries-old puppet theatre tradition to craft a world where every path, every light, and every camera movement draws you deeper into the performance.
 
Missed the first episode? Catch it on our channel, and stay tuned for more! 🎥
